title: The No Charge chip shows in Tech View and on the phone
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a desktop browser at least 1440 pixels wide.
  • Have a phone signed in to ShopView as the same Admin, or a second browser window narrowed to 390 pixels wide.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, line 2 marked No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1 in the desktop browser.
  2. Switch to the Tech View display.
  3. Hover over the "No Charge" chip on line 2.
  4. Open work order 1 on the phone.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Line 2 shows the chip "No Charge" in Tech View.
  • The chip shows only the words "No Charge", with no category name in it.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip reads "Category: Goodwill".

Step 4:

  • Line 2 shows the chip "No Charge" and $0.00 on the phone layout.
  • The chip shows only the words "No Charge", with no category name in it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.4 (13 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R3: “A no-charge line shows the chip "No Charge" next to its title on the lines table, in Tech View and on mobile, with the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, as the work order badge has (S2-R16); the category itself is not printed in the chip; Rate, Total and every part on it show $0.00; Margin shows nothing. Hours, technician, status, approval, parts ordering, picking, receiving, clock-ins, notes, inspections and the story work as on any line. The original work order and line are not shown on the line; they are in the notes, the Audit Log, the report and the hub record.”
  • Story 12, Form factor: “Form factor: Mobile-optimized. The line menu item, the chip and the $0.00 price follow the line on desktop, Tech View and the mobile app; the dialogs are the existing dialog pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794565397-7f4c (read and rendered 14 Nov 2026: from version 1794561577-f903 one string changed, the chip of a no-charge line now reads "No Charge" on 6 boards; the other 161 boards are pixel-identical): boards "03 Line marked No Charge · $0.00" (page "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order"), "32 Line marked No Charge · $0.00" (page "Happy flow v6"). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow6-03-03-line-marked-no-charge-0-00-v14.png
  • iwo-happy-32-32-line-marked-no-charge-0-00-v14.png

The older pictures also attached to this case (iwo-flow6-03-03-line-marked-no-charge-0-00.png, iwo-happy-32-32-line-marked-no-charge-0-00.png) show the chip as "No Charge · Warranty", before the design was changed on 13 Nov 2026: ignore them for this check.

The design's own words:

  • “No Charge”
  • “$0.00”

Register IWO-N45 on S12-R3 (design silent): the boards draw the chip "No Charge" but no tooltip; PRD v1.4 S12-R3 states the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, so this case follows the PRD.
